dct_description_sm: "Natural Earth v. 6.0 was the primary source of base map data, including land cover, bathymetry, coastlines, rivers, lakes, and glaciers. Natural Earth also provided river and lake names. PeakVisor and Wikipedia were the source of mountain names and elevations. Other physical feature names derive from multiple references, including recent atlases and online maps. GEBCO was the source for seafloor feature names. SRTM data rendered in Eduard software produced the shaded relief."
